map.质量定律隔声量：TL = 20·log₁₀(f·m) − 48（dB，f 频率: Mass-law sound reduction index: TL = 20·log₁₀(f·m) − 48 (dB, f frequency in Hz, m surface density in kg/m²); linked value: surface-density–frequency product back-solved = 10^((TL+48)÷20). Validation: required guards for f and m (their product is the implicit variable, and the law only makes physical sense for m > 0). Criteria: no fixed grading; doubling either the frequency or the surface density adds about 6 dB (empirical law for a single homogeneous wall).
